description: Set the cushion. **What is in the bank** is the latest statement balance of the bank accounts that count — **every bank account and cash, until `accounts` unticks it**; **each goal saved in one of them holds its part** (its deposits into that account’s own cash holding), and **the cushion is what is left**, against a target of `months` of bills plus the Plan `buckets` (Groceries, say) counted beside the bills. No goal is the cushion and setting it makes none. Goals holding more than an account, or than the whole, is a failed check, never shrunk to fit. Every answer ends with the split as it stands. Wealth › Net worth and Plan both show it. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

accounts.description: Bank accounts whose balance counts toward what is in the bank, or stops counting. A card or an account with holdings never counts.

account.description: The account, by id, name or last four digits.

counts.description: True counts its balance; false stops counting it.

buckets.description: Plan buckets to count in the cushion, or to stop counting. Ids or names from `plans`.

bucket.description: The bucket, by id or by name.

counted.description: True counts it among the months; false stops counting it.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

months.description: How many months of bills, above 0 and at most 24, to two places. e.g. 3.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: set_cushion
title: Set the cushion
